description: This file is a PHP class definition for a controller named Header within the Opencart admin module. It extends a system controller and manages the rendering of the header component in the admin interface, including loading language strings, user info, notifications, and generating URLs for various parts of the admin panel.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating the header section in the admin interface, handling data population for language, user info, notifications, and links.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Builds and returns the view for the header section, populating data with language, title, user info, notifications, and URLs for navigation.
